insights.one_liner: Data and research firm working on international development, with 80+ staff across the Netherlands, East Africa and Peru, and an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: A data, research and analytics firm working on development challenges for clients like the World Bank and the Mastercard Foundation.
Has 80+ full-time staff and more than 2,000 survey enumerators, so it feels small at the core but works at large scale.
Partners with universities, think tanks, NGOs and government ministries.

open.text: Laterite B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Operates in the Netherlands, Rwanda, Ethiopia, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Sierra Leone and Peru.
